serviceContent.title: Feature
serviceContent.description: Powerful capabilities that transform your field sales operation

salesFeature.subtitle: Protect Sensitive Customer Data
salesFeature.title: Every Rep, One Assigned Customer
description: Assign specific customers to your each rep. Overlap - No Confusion.
This ensures no overlaps and no missed visits.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Sales Discipline
salesFeature.title: No Wrong Practice. Ever.
description: When a rep reaches the customer's location, he simply taps check-in.
You know the visit actually happened — no WhatsApp updates needed.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Collections Firewall
salesFeature.title: Get Paid Before You Sell.
description: Reps see the client's Real-Time Outstanding & Credit Limit before they take an order. The system prompts collection immediately
If dues are high, the system prompts, — collect first, then order.
No more selling to bad paymasters.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Schemes Engine
salesFeature.title: No Wrong Pricing. Ever.
description: Buy 10 Get 1? 5% Discount on Cash? The app auto-applies schemes based on your Tally logic. No rep calculation errors.
Buy 10 Get 1?
5% discount for cash?
All items above ₹50,000 get slab pricing?
The app applies all schemes automatically based on your rules.
Reps never miscalculate. Orders stay accurate. Primary sales rise because schemes are used fully.

salesFeature.subtitle: Manager Instant Approval
salesFeature.title: No Calls. No PDFs. Just Approve.
description: Managers get order alerts instantly.
Approve or reject with one tap.
Fast approvals keep dispatch moving without delays.

salesFeature.subtitle: One-Click Sync to Tally
salesFeature.title: E-Invoices Flow In Automatically
description: Approved orders convert to e-invoices and sync to Tally as sales vouchers instantly.
Have your Invoice Specific UPI QR Code on Invoice for Smoother Collections & Tracking.
Your accountant does zero typing.
Zero mismatch. Zero backlog.

salesFeature.subtitle: Auto-Reconciliation with the Bank
salesFeature.title: No One Asks, Has the Payment Come?
description: When money lands in the bank, Effortless updates automatically.
Collections reflect instantly across the manager dashboard and owner's view.
Reps, finance, and leadership always see the same number.

salesFeature.subtitle: Owner Visibility Panel
salesFeature.title: Orders. Dues. Cash. All in One Screen.
description: Owners see
Today's orders
Today's collections
Pending by customer
Branch-wise and rep-wise performance
Scheme-driven sales lift
Cash stuck in overdue customers
Everything updates in real time.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Final Truth Remains True
salesFeature.title: Tally Stays Updated. Always.
description: Approved Orders, Invoices, and Collections move into Tally without typing.
Masters stay clean, reconciliations stay simple, and audit stays smooth.
